Lack of fusion ( incomplete fusion )

Lack of union between weld metal and parent metal or weld metal and weld metal. It will be one of the following: -- lack of side wall fusion. - lack of inter-run fusionl, - lack of fusion antthe root of the weld.

CRACK A-l. This annex is intended: between the two numbering systems regarding the level of NUMBERING

for one part, to avoid confusion interpretation;

-

for the other part, to permit users of the IIW numbering have a transition period in which to conform with the International Standard.

system already being applied to numbering system defined in this

A-2. The number references of various types of crack are given mostly in respect of their location, these being in the weld metal, at the weld junction, in the heat-affected zone or in the parent metal, so it was decided to identify systematically identical locations by the same last digit. Examples longitudinal transverse crack ( in the parent metal ) : 1014
